▪KTC has joined the “Clear Debt, Move Forward ” as a Non -Bank financial services provider 
under the Krungthai  Bank Group
▪The initiative aims to accelerate NPL resolution, reduce household debt stress, and 
support customers ’ financial recovery
▪Program targets unsecured retail borrowers classified as NPL, with principal or interest 
overdue more than 90 days
▪Eligibility is determined using each customer ’s debt status as of 30September 2025
▪Qualified borrowers must have total NPL exposure across all financial institutions not 
exceeding THB 100,000 per person
▪KTC will transfer qualifying unsecured NPL accounts to Sukhumvit Asset Management 
(SAM) for centralized workout
▪SAM will offer restructured repayment plans, flexible terms, and negotiated debt 
reduction, enabling customers to sustainably rehabilitate debt
▪Registration opens via Bank of Thailand channels beginning 5 January 2026

Personal Loan Activities
KTC PROUD
Q2 2026 : Expand Onboarding Acquisition and Enhance Everyday Usage
KTC  continues  to expand  its financial  services  into customers’  
“moments  of real  purchase  intent”  through  ecosystem  of smart  phone  
and ICT merchant  more  than  1,500 stores  nationwide . By enabling  
seamless  QR-based  onboarding  with  approval  results  within  30 minutes,  
KTC  enhances  accessibility  to responsible  credit  solutions  while  
transforming  these  stores  into high -efficiency  acquisition  and 
engagement  channels . 
KTC  aims  to evolve  KTC  PROUD  to an “everyday  financial  solution”  
empowering  members  manage  their  usage  seamlessly  across  daily  
needs . Beside  from  strengthening  customer  engagement  and 
responding  to all financial  lifestyles  through  “Swipe,  Transfer,  Cash  
Withdrawal,  and Installment”  capabilities,  expanding  long -term  0% 
installment  offerings  for technology  and digital  devices  that  support  
working,  learning,  and income  generation  will drive  sustainable  
installment  growth  and build  long -term  quality  growth  across  the 
portfolio .
